title: 正式书面沟通与表达精度 · 86 句
description: 文件版本、授权范围、会议安排与纪要、交付说明、更正、催办、公告和证据精度。

items.zh: 请以附件中的修订版为准，昨天发送的版本已作废。
items.en: Please refer to the attached revision; the version sent yesterday is no longer valid.
answers: Please refer to the attached revision; the version sent yesterday is no longer valid.
items.notes: refer to：查阅或参照；no longer valid 明确旧版本状态。

items.zh: 为方便核对，我用黄色标出了所有改动。
items.en: For ease of comparison, I have highlighted every change in yellow.
answers: For ease of comparison, I have highlighted every change in yellow.
items.notes: for ease of：为了便于；highlight in yellow：用黄色标出。

items.zh: 正文中的编号与附录中的编号一一对应。
items.en: The numbers in the main text correspond directly to those in the appendix.
answers: The numbers in the main text correspond directly to those in the appendix.
items.notes: correspond to：与……对应；those 代替 numbers。

items.zh: 第二份附件包含原始表格，第一份只是一页摘要。
items.en: The second attachment contains the original tables, whereas the first is a one-page summary.
answers: The second attachment contains the original tables, whereas the first is a one-page summary.
items.notes: whereas 对照附件用途；one-page 修饰 summary。

items.zh: 这份草案尚未获得批准，请在引用时注明其状态。
items.en: This draft has yet to be approved, so please state its status when citing it.
answers: This draft has yet to be approved, so please state its status when citing it.
items.notes: has yet to be approved：尚未获批。

items.zh: 扫描件的最后一页似乎缺失了，能否单独补发？
items.en: The final page appears to be missing from the scan. Could you send it separately?
answers: The final page appears to be missing from the scan. Could you send it separately?
items.notes: appears to 表示基于当前文件作出的谨慎判断。

items.zh: 我保留了原有标题，以便读者继续使用旧目录查找。
items.en: I have retained the original headings so that readers can still use the earlier contents list.
answers: I have retained the original headings so that readers can still use the earlier contents list.
items.notes: so that 说明保留标题的目的。

items.zh: 表格底部的脚注适用于整列数据。
items.en: The footnote beneath the table applies to the entire column.
answers: The footnote beneath the table applies to the entire column.
items.notes: apply to：适用于；entire 明确覆盖范围。

items.zh: 请不要把批注中的建议当作已经通过的修改。
items.en: Please do not treat suggestions in the comments as approved amendments.
answers: Please do not treat suggestions in the comments as approved amendments.
Please don't treat suggestions in the comments as approved amendments.
items.notes: treat A as B：将 A 视为 B。

items.zh: 如果你引用了更新后的数字，也请同步修改图注。
items.en: If you cite the updated figures, please revise the chart caption accordingly.
answers: If you cite the updated figures, please revise the chart caption accordingly.
items.notes: accordingly：作相应调整；caption：图注。

items.zh: 我可以确认收件，但无权代表委员会接受这些条款。
items.en: I can acknowledge receipt but am not authorised to accept these terms on behalf of the committee.
answers: I can acknowledge receipt but am not authorised to accept these terms on behalf of the committee.
items.notes: on behalf of：代表；确认收到不等于接受条款。

items.zh: 这封邮件只确认交付日期，未批准额外支出。
items.en: This email confirms the delivery date only and does not approve additional expenditure.
answers: This email confirms the delivery date only and does not approve additional expenditure.
This email confirms the delivery date only and doesn't approve additional expenditure.
items.notes: only 限定确认范围；expenditure：支出。

items.zh: 请将任何超出原定范围的工作单独列项报价。
items.en: Please quote separately for any work beyond the agreed scope.
answers: Please quote separately for any work beyond the agreed scope.
items.notes: quote for：为某项工作报价；agreed scope：约定范围。

items.zh: 技术问题由我负责，账单相关事宜请联系财务团队。
items.en: I will handle technical matters; billing enquiries should go to the finance team.
answers: I will handle technical matters; billing enquiries should go to the finance team.
items.notes: 用并列分句划清两类问题的负责人。

items.zh: 在负责人书面确认之前，这项安排仍属临时性质。
items.en: The arrangement remains provisional until the person responsible confirms it in writing.
answers: The arrangement remains provisional until the person responsible confirms it in writing.
items.notes: provisional：暂定的；in writing：以书面形式。

items.zh: 授权仅限于此次活动，不延伸到后续宣传。
items.en: Permission is limited to this event and does not extend to subsequent publicity.
answers: Permission is limited to this event and does not extend to subsequent publicity.
Permission is limited to this event and doesn't extend to subsequent publicity.
items.notes: be limited to 与 extend to 明确许可边界。

items.zh: 我提出的是供讨论的建议，并非对执行团队的指令。
items.en: I am offering a proposal for discussion, rather than an instruction to the implementation team.
answers: I am offering a proposal for discussion, rather than an instruction to the implementation team.
items.notes: rather than 区分建议与指令的语用效力。

items.zh: 双方各自承担本方员工的差旅费用。
items.en: Each party will cover the travel expenses of its own staff.
answers: Each party will cover the travel expenses of its own staff.
items.notes: each party 单数；its own 明确各自承担。

items.zh: 接收设备并不意味着我们已经验收其性能。
items.en: Taking delivery of the equipment does not mean that we have accepted its performance.
answers: Taking delivery of the equipment does not mean that we have accepted its performance.
Taking delivery of the equipment doesn't mean that we have accepted its performance.
items.notes: take delivery of：接收交付；区分收货和性能验收。

items.zh: 若需要由其他人签署，请提供其姓名及授权依据。
items.en: If someone else needs to sign, please provide their name and the basis of their authority.
answers: If someone else needs to sign, please provide their name and the basis of their authority.
items.notes: the basis of their authority：授权依据；their 可指性别未明的单个人。

items.zh: 由于参会人员来自三个时区，邀请中会同时列出各地时间。
items.en: As participants are joining from three time zones, the invitation will show the time in each location.
answers: As participants are joining from three time zones, the invitation will show the time in each location.
items.notes: as 引出安排的原因；each location 避免时区歧义。

items.zh: 此次讨论预留四十五分钟，其中最后十分钟用于确认下一步。
items.en: Forty-five minutes have been set aside for this discussion, including ten at the end to agree the next steps.
answers: Forty-five minutes have been set aside for this discussion, including ten at the end to agree the next steps.
items.notes: set aside：预留；including 引出总时长中的一部分。

items.zh: 如果这个议题需要更多时间，我们可以另约一次专门会议。
items.en: Should this issue require more time, we can arrange a separate meeting devoted to it.
answers: Should this issue require more time, we can arrange a separate meeting devoted to it.
items.notes: should 引导省略 if 的条件倒装；devoted to：专门用于。

items.zh: 请告知你是否需要口译，以便我们提前安排。
items.en: Please let us know whether you require an interpreter so that we can make arrangements in advance.
answers: Please let us know whether you require an interpreter so that we can make arrangements in advance.
items.notes: interpreter 指口译员；whether 引导间接问句。

items.zh: 线上参会链接将在会议前一天发送给已登记人员。
items.en: The link for remote participation will be sent to registered attendees the day before the meeting.
answers: The link for remote participation will be sent to registered attendees the day before the meeting.
items.notes: registered attendees：已登记参会者。

items.zh: 议程已留出一项开放讨论，未列明的问题可在该环节提出。
items.en: An open discussion is included in the agenda, during which unlisted issues may be raised.
answers: An open discussion is included in the agenda, during which unlisted issues may be raised.
items.notes: during which 回指讨论环节；raise an issue：提出问题。

items.zh: 若你只能参加前半场，请先审阅与你有关的议题。
items.en: If you can attend only the first half, please review the items relevant to you beforehand.
answers: If you can attend only the first half, please review the items relevant to you beforehand.
items.notes: relevant to：与……有关；beforehand：事先。

items.zh: 实地参观需要穿封闭式鞋，现场将提供其他防护用品。
items.en: Closed-toe shoes are required for the site visit; other protective equipment will be provided on arrival.
answers: Closed-toe shoes are required for the site visit; other protective equipment will be provided on arrival.
items.notes: closed-toe shoes：包住脚趾的鞋；equipment 不可数。

items.zh: 为了让讨论有依据，请带上一份能代表常见问题的案例。
items.en: Please bring a representative case to give the discussion a concrete basis.
answers: Please bring a representative case to give the discussion a concrete basis.
items.notes: representative case：有代表性的案例；不只是随意举例。

items.zh: 会后无需另行发送出席证明，我们将统一记录。
items.en: There is no need to send separate confirmation of attendance afterwards; we will keep a central record.
answers: There is no need to send separate confirmation of attendance afterwards; we will keep a central record.
items.notes: there is no need to 表示免除额外手续。

items.zh: 记录应区分已经达成的决定和尚待讨论的提议。
items.en: The minutes should distinguish decisions reached from proposals still under discussion.
answers: The minutes should distinguish decisions reached from proposals still under discussion.
items.notes: distinguish A from B；minutes 在此指会议记录。

items.zh: 我们同意先试行两周，再决定是否全面采用。
items.en: We agreed to run a two-week trial before deciding whether to adopt the arrangement in full.
answers: We agreed to run a two-week trial before deciding whether to adopt the arrangement in full.
items.notes: agree to do；before deciding 说明决策顺序。

items.zh: 这一点尚未形成共识，因此请勿在纪要中写成一致通过。
items.en: No consensus was reached on this point, so please do not record it as unanimously approved.
answers: No consensus was reached on this point, so please do not record it as unanimously approved.
No consensus was reached on this point, so please don't record it as unanimously approved.
items.notes: consensus：共识；unanimously：一致地。

items.zh: 行动清单为每项任务列明了负责人和截止日期。
items.en: The action list names an owner and a deadline for each task.
answers: The action list names an owner and a deadline for each task.
items.notes: owner 在任务管理中指负责人。

items.zh: 我对预算部分有保留意见，希望将这一点写入记录。
items.en: I have reservations about the budget section and would like them entered in the record.
answers: I have reservations about the budget section and would like them entered in the record.
items.notes: have reservations about：对……持保留意见。

items.zh: 会议讨论了延期的可能性，但并未批准延期。
items.en: The meeting considered a possible extension but did not approve one.
answers: The meeting considered a possible extension but did not approve one.
The meeting considered a possible extension but didn't approve one.
items.notes: one 代替 extension；consider 不等于 approve。

items.zh: 请把我的发言更正为“可能减少成本”，而不是“一定减少成本”。
items.en: Please correct the record of my statement to say that costs may fall, not that they definitely will.
answers: Please correct the record of my statement to say that costs may fall, not that they definitely will.
items.notes: may 与 definitely 的确定程度不同。

items.zh: 缺席成员可以提交书面意见，但不能被计为现场投票者。
items.en: Absent members may submit written comments but cannot be counted as having voted in person.
answers: Absent members may submit written comments but cannot be counted as having voted in person.
Absent members may submit written comments but can't be counted as having voted in person.
items.notes: be counted as having done：被计入已完成某行为者。

items.zh: 旧决议继续有效，直到新的安排正式获批。
items.en: The earlier resolution remains in force until the new arrangement is formally approved.
answers: The earlier resolution remains in force until the new arrangement is formally approved.
items.notes: remain in force：继续有效。

items.zh: 附件列出了会后补充的信息，并注明了来源。
items.en: The attachment lists information added after the meeting and identifies its sources.
answers: The attachment lists information added after the meeting and identifies its sources.
items.notes: added after the meeting 限定会后补充材料。

items.zh: 交付包中附有一份清单，标明每个文件的用途。
items.en: The delivery package includes an index explaining what each file is for.
answers: The delivery package includes an index explaining what each file is for.
items.notes: what each file is for 用间接问句说明用途。

items.zh: 图片的预览版带有水印，正式授权版本则没有。
items.en: The preview images carry watermarks, which are absent from the licensed versions.
answers: The preview images carry watermarks, which are absent from the licensed versions.
items.notes: which 回指 watermarks；licensed：已授权的。

items.zh: 请先复制一份模板，再填写你自己的信息。
items.en: Please make a copy of the template before entering your own details.
answers: Please make a copy of the template before entering your own details.
items.notes: make a copy：制作副本；before 表示必要顺序。

items.zh: 灰色单元格含有公式，直接输入会覆盖计算结果。
items.en: The grey cells contain formulas; typing into them will overwrite the calculations.
answers: The grey cells contain formulas; typing into them will overwrite the calculations.
items.notes: overwrite：覆盖已有内容。

items.zh: 目录中的链接指向文件夹内部，移动单个文件可能导致链接失效。
items.en: The index links point within the folder, so moving individual files may break them.
answers: The index links point within the folder, so moving individual files may break them.
items.notes: break links：使链接失效；them 回指 links。

items.zh: 此说明假定读者已完成安装，安装步骤另有文档。
items.en: These instructions assume that installation is complete; the installation steps are documented separately.
answers: These instructions assume that installation is complete; the installation steps are documented separately.
items.notes: assume that 明确文档适用前提。

items.zh: 示例中的姓名和地址均为虚构，仅用于演示格式。
items.en: The names and addresses in the example are fictional and serve only to demonstrate the format.
answers: The names and addresses in the example are fictional and serve only to demonstrate the format.
items.notes: serve to：用于；fictional：虚构的。

items.zh: 可编辑原稿与只读副本存放在不同的子文件夹中。
items.en: Editable source files and read-only copies are stored in separate subfolders.
answers: Editable source files and read-only copies are stored in separate subfolders.
items.notes: editable 与 read-only 区分两种用途。

items.zh: 本次交付不包含历史记录，因为它们不在约定范围之内。
items.en: Historical records are excluded from this delivery because they fall outside the agreed scope.
answers: Historical records are excluded from this delivery because they fall outside the agreed scope.
items.notes: fall outside the scope：超出范围。

items.zh: 若文件无法打开，请告知文件名及屏幕上显示的错误信息。
items.en: If a file will not open, please report its name and the error message shown on screen.
answers: If a file will not open, please report its name and the error message shown on screen.
If a file won't open, please report its name and the error message shown on screen.
items.notes: will not 可表示设备或文件无法正常响应。

items.zh: 我在上一封邮件中把两项费用对调了，正确明细如下。
items.en: I transposed two charges in my previous email; the correct breakdown follows.
answers: I transposed two charges in my previous email; the correct breakdown follows.
items.notes: transpose：将位置对调；breakdown：分类明细。

items.zh: 日期中的月份有误，但已确认的星期和时间不变。
items.en: The month in the date was incorrect, but the agreed day of the week and time remain unchanged.
answers: The month in the date was incorrect, but the agreed day of the week and time remain unchanged.
items.notes: day of the week 指星期几，避免与具体日期混淆。

items.zh: 补充说明一下，该金额不包含可退还的押金。
items.en: For clarification, the amount excludes the refundable deposit.
answers: For clarification, the amount excludes the refundable deposit.
items.notes: for clarification：为澄清起见；refundable：可退还的。

items.zh: 措辞可能让人误以为这是强制要求，我的本意是提出建议。
items.en: The wording may have suggested a compulsory requirement; I intended it as a recommendation.
answers: The wording may have suggested a compulsory requirement; I intended it as a recommendation.
items.notes: may have done 表示对过去效果的可能判断。

items.zh: 我们发现了一处计算错误，因此撤回先前的估算。
items.en: We have identified a calculation error and are therefore withdrawing the earlier estimate.
answers: We have identified a calculation error and are therefore withdrawing the earlier estimate.
items.notes: withdraw an estimate：撤回估算。

items.zh: 更正仅涉及标签，底层数据没有变化。
items.en: The correction concerns the labels only; the underlying data are unchanged.
answers: The correction concerns the labels only; the underlying data are unchanged.
items.notes: underlying data：底层数据；only 限定修改范围。

items.zh: 我之前遗漏了一个条件：场地只能在办公时间内使用。
items.en: I omitted one condition earlier: the venue is available during office hours only.
answers: I omitted one condition earlier: the venue is available during office hours only.
items.notes: omit：遗漏；冒号引出被遗漏条件。

items.zh: 请允许我澄清“完成”的含义：文件已提交，但审查仍在进行。
items.en: Let me clarify what I meant by complete: the documents have been submitted, but the review is ongoing.
answers: Let me clarify what I meant by complete: the documents have been submitted, but the review is ongoing.
items.notes: 区分提交完成和审核完成；ongoing：仍在进行。

items.zh: 为避免歧义，下文中的“客户”均指签约单位。
items.en: To avoid ambiguity, client refers throughout the text below to the contracting organisation.
answers: To avoid ambiguity, client refers throughout the text below to the contracting organisation.
items.notes: throughout：贯穿全文；明确术语所指。

items.zh: 我们采用的是发货日期，而不是订单创建日期。
items.en: We have used the dispatch date rather than the date on which the order was created.
answers: We have used the dispatch date rather than the date on which the order was created.
items.notes: on which 修饰 date；明确计算或记录的时间依据。

items.zh: 为赶上印刷排期，我们需要在周三中午前收到最终文本。
items.en: To meet the print schedule, we need the final text by noon on Wednesday.
answers: To meet the print schedule, we need the final text by noon on Wednesday.
items.notes: meet a schedule：按期完成；by 指最迟时间。

items.zh: 若目前还无法给出完整答复，请先告知预计回复时间。
items.en: If a full response is not yet possible, please indicate when we can expect one.
answers: If a full response is not yet possible, please indicate when we can expect one.
If a full response isn't yet possible, please indicate when we can expect one.
items.notes: one 代替 response；给出可执行的替代回应。

items.zh: 我再次附上所需清单，方便你核对缺少的材料。
items.en: I have reattached the checklist to help you identify any outstanding documents.
answers: I have reattached the checklist to help you identify any outstanding documents.
items.notes: outstanding documents 指尚未交齐的文件。

items.zh: 在收到尺寸确认之前，供应商无法开始制作。
items.en: The supplier cannot begin production until the dimensions have been confirmed.
answers: The supplier cannot begin production until the dimensions have been confirmed.
The supplier can't begin production until the dimensions have been confirmed.
items.notes: not ... until 表明后续工作依赖尺寸确认。

items.zh: 如果你已经发送了回复，请忽略这封提醒邮件。
items.en: If you have already replied, please disregard this reminder.
answers: If you have already replied, please disregard this reminder.
items.notes: disregard：忽略；条件句避免重复催办。

items.zh: 我们已收到全部资料，本阶段无需你采取进一步行动。
items.en: We have received all the material and require no further action from you at this stage.
answers: We have received all the material and require no further action from you at this stage.
items.notes: at this stage 限定当前阶段，避免暗示永远无后续。

items.zh: 该问题已转交负责团队，并附上此前的往来记录。
items.en: The matter has been referred to the team responsible, together with the earlier correspondence.
answers: The matter has been referred to the team responsible, together with the earlier correspondence.
items.notes: refer a matter to：将事项转交；correspondence 不可数。

items.zh: 如未收到明确确认，我们将继续按原定安排执行。
items.en: Without explicit confirmation, we will proceed with the original arrangements.
answers: Without explicit confirmation, we will proceed with the original arrangements.
items.notes: without 引出缺少确认时的处理方式。

items.zh: 谢谢你指出这一遗漏；它已在最新版本中补上。
items.en: Thank you for drawing attention to the omission; it has been addressed in the latest version.
answers: Thank you for drawing attention to the omission; it has been addressed in the latest version.
items.notes: draw attention to：指出；address an omission：补上遗漏。

items.zh: 待最后一项费用结清后，我们会发送结项通知。
items.en: Once the final charge has been settled, we will issue a notice of closure.
answers: Once the final charge has been settled, we will issue a notice of closure.
items.notes: settle a charge：结清费用；once 引出结项条件。

items.zh: 维护期间，自助服务暂停，人工柜台照常开放。
items.en: During maintenance, self-service facilities will be unavailable, while staffed counters will remain open.
answers: During maintenance, self-service facilities will be unavailable, while staffed counters will remain open.
items.notes: while 对照受影响和继续开放的服务。

items.zh: 新收费只适用于生效日期之后提交的申请。
items.en: The revised fee applies only to applications submitted after the effective date.
answers: The revised fee applies only to applications submitted after the effective date.
items.notes: effective date：生效日期；only 限定适用申请。

items.zh: 报名按收到完整材料的先后顺序处理。
items.en: Registrations are processed in the order in which complete applications are received.
answers: Registrations are processed in the order in which complete applications are received.
items.notes: in the order in which：按……的顺序。

items.zh: 名额已满后，申请人可选择加入候补名单。
items.en: Once all places have been filled, applicants may opt to join the waiting list.
answers: Once all places have been filled, applicants may opt to join the waiting list.
items.notes: opt to do：选择做；waiting list：候补名单。

items.zh: 本公告替代此前关于开放时间的通知。
items.en: This announcement supersedes the earlier notice concerning opening hours.
answers: This announcement supersedes the earlier notice concerning opening hours.
items.notes: supersede：取代并使先前版本不再适用。

items.zh: 任何变更都会在此页面公布，并注明更新时间。
items.en: Any changes will be published on this page with the time of the update.
answers: Any changes will be published on this page with the time of the update.
items.notes: with 补充更新信息，明确查询位置。

items.zh: 公开摘要已删除个人信息，但保留了主要结论。
items.en: Personal information has been removed from the public summary, while the main findings have been retained.
answers: Personal information has been removed from the public summary, while the main findings have been retained.
items.notes: remove 与 retain 对照删去和保留内容。

items.zh: 所收集的联系方式仅用于协调本次活动。
items.en: The contact details collected will be used solely to coordinate this event.
answers: The contact details collected will be used solely to coordinate this event.
items.notes: solely 限定使用目的；collected 后置修饰 details。

items.zh: 读者可申请无障碍版本，无需另付费用。
items.en: An accessible version is available on request at no additional charge.
answers: An accessible version is available on request at no additional charge.
items.notes: on request：按申请提供；at no additional charge：不另收费。

items.zh: 此链接将在月底失效，请及时下载所需材料。
items.en: This link will expire at the end of the month, so please download any material you need beforehand.
answers: This link will expire at the end of the month, so please download any material you need beforehand.
items.notes: expire：失效；beforehand 回指到期前。

items.zh: 请区分“没有收到投诉”和“没有发生问题”。
items.en: Please distinguish receiving no complaints from experiencing no problems.
answers: Please distinguish receiving no complaints from experiencing no problems.
items.notes: 没有反馈记录并不等于没有事件；distinguish A from B。

items.zh: 这份记录反映的是当时已知的信息，而非后续调查的全部结果。
items.en: This record reflects what was known at the time, rather than the full findings of the subsequent investigation.
answers: This record reflects what was known at the time, rather than the full findings of the subsequent investigation.
items.notes: what was known 限定当时知识范围。

items.zh: 预估区间包含不确定性，不应将上限当作承诺。
items.en: The estimated range allows for uncertainty; its upper limit should not be treated as a commitment.
answers: The estimated range allows for uncertainty; its upper limit should not be treated as a commitment.
The estimated range allows for uncertainty; its upper limit shouldn't be treated as a commitment.
items.notes: allow for：考虑到；上限不等于承诺。

items.zh: 受访者描述的是自身经历，我们尚未独立核实这些叙述。
items.en: Respondents described their own experiences, and we have not independently verified their accounts.
answers: Respondents described their own experiences, and we have not independently verified their accounts.
Respondents described their own experiences, and we haven't independently verified their accounts.
items.notes: account 在此指叙述；区分报告内容与核实结果。

items.zh: “未评估”表示没有作出判断，并不表示已经判定不合格。
items.en: Not assessed means that no judgement has been made, not that a failure has been established.
answers: Not assessed means that no judgement has been made, not that a failure has been established.
items.notes: 未评估与不合格是不同状态，不能相互替代。

items.zh: 请保留原文中的限定词，以免把初步结论写成确定事实。
items.en: Please retain the qualifiers in the original text to avoid presenting tentative conclusions as established facts.
answers: Please retain the qualifiers in the original text to avoid presenting tentative conclusions as established facts.
items.notes: qualifier：限定词；tentative：初步的、暂定的。
